shop_items_sale_window_order.name: shop_items_sale_window_order
shop_items_sale_window_order.value: "shop_items"."available_from" is null or "shop_items"."available_until" is null or "shop_items"."available_until" > "shop_items"."available_from"

shop_items_image_when_visual.name: shop_items_image_when_visual
shop_items_image_when_visual.value: "shop_items"."category" not in ('pet', 'avatar') or "shop_items"."image_url" is not null

shop_items_cosmetic_fields.name: shop_items_cosmetic_fields
shop_items_cosmetic_fields.value: ("shop_items"."category" = 'cosmetic') = ("shop_items"."cosmetic_kind" is not null and "shop_items"."cosmetic_value" is not null)
